rankings.howCalculatedIntro: Rankings are computed from five components plus a roster talent prior that tapers off as the season progresses. Each component is normalised relative to the rest of the league (best team = 1.0, worst = 0.0) before weighting, so rankings reflect where a team stands right now.
rankings.componentPointsDesc: Points earned divided by maximum possible (games played × 2). The primary measure of season-long success.
rankings.componentL10Desc: Same formula applied to the last 10 games only. This is what moves rankings week to week — a hot team climbs, a cold team falls regardless of earlier results.
rankings.componentGDDesc: Goals scored minus goals allowed per game. Teams that win convincingly rank higher than teams that constantly squeak by one goal.
rankings.componentXGFDesc: Expected goals for % at even strength — the share of shot quality a team generates versus allows at 5-on-5. Filters out goaltending and shooting luck that inflate or deflate raw goal totals.
rankings.componentSPDesc: Average of power play % and penalty kill %. Weighted lower than even-strength play because special teams frequency and opponent quality vary.
rankings.componentWARDesc: Sum of the top-18 skaters' Wins Above Replacement plus the starter's Goals Saved Above Expected. Weighted at 15% at game 0, tapering to 0% by game 20. Ensures pre-season and early-season rankings reflect roster quality rather than a handful of fluky results.
rankings.howCalculatedFootnote: xGF% and Roster WAR show — until the first nightly pipeline run populates them. All other components still produce a valid rank.

advanced.shotExplainFull: Corsi For% (CF%) approximates all shot attempts using shots on goal + blocked shots from the NHL realtime report. Fenwick For% (FF%) uses shots on goal only, excluding blocked shots. Both measure territorial control — ≥50% means {{abbr}} is generating more attempts than opponents.
advanced.shotExplainProxy: Shot For% is a SOG-based proxy. Realtime blocked shot data unavailable for this game type.
advanced.cfNote: All shot attempts for ÷ total. ≥50% = territorial control
advanced.ffNote: Unblocked attempts for ÷ total. Filters out shot-blocking luck
advanced.proxyNote: SOG for ÷ total SOG. ≥50% = outshooting opponents
advanced.blockedForNote: Shots blocked by {{abbr}} skaters per game
advanced.blockedAgainstNote: {{abbr}} shots blocked by opponents per game
advanced.possessionNote: Time with puck ÷ total play time
advanced.pdoExplain: PDO = team shooting% + save% × 100. League average = 100. Values above 102 suggest positive puck luck likely to regress; below 98 suggest negative luck. Useful for identifying unsustainable streaks.
advanced.netPpExplain: Net PP% excludes goals where the opposing team was also shorthanded simultaneously.
advanced.netPkExplain: Net PK% excludes goals while both teams were shorthanded simultaneously.
advanced.loadingSub: These come from the NHL stats API and may take a moment.

trends.scoreFirstInfoTip: How often {{abbr}} has scored the first goal of the game, rolling 10-game window. Each bar = one game; bar height = % of the last 10 games where {{abbr}} scored first.
